bugs.title: Coupon codes FIXED5 and QA rejected as 'not valid' — promotions P11/P02 not valid for B2B TechFlow org context
bugs.failedAssertion: [DOM] coupon accepted confirmation or discount line visible
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Sign in as org user (TechFlow / John Mitchell slot). 2. Add any in-stock item to cart. 3. Navigate to /cart. 4. In Discount & coupons sidebar, type 'QA' (or 'FIXED5') in the Custom code input. 5. Click the Apply arrow button.
bugs.expected: Coupon QA accepted; discount line shows -$20.00; total reduced by $20.00 (BL-CART-003). Coupon FIXED5 accepted; discount shows -$5.00.
bugs.actual: Alert 'This code is not valid' shown for both QA and FIXED5. Apply button disabled. Discount $0.00. promotionCoupons API response does not include QA/FIXED5/COU-002/COU-019 for this B2B org context.

bugs.title: Coupon QA rejected for B2B org user — blocks CART-042 coupon persistence test
bugs.failedAssertion: [DOM] coupon QA accepted — discount line visible before sign-out
bugs.stepsToReproduce: 1. Sign in as org user (TechFlow). 2. Add items to cart. 3. Navigate to /cart. 4. Apply coupon 'QA'. Observe 'This code is not valid'.
bugs.expected: Coupon QA accepted (BL-CART-003); can then verify persistence across sign-out/sign-in (BL-CART-006).
bugs.actual: Coupon rejected at application step. Same root cause as BUG_029_001.
